about:
Suntronic is an electronics manufacturing services (EMS) provider headquartered in Richardson, Texas, with production facilities in Houston and Dallas. The company was founded in 1995 and has operated as a privately held business since its inception.

It offers a full range of contract manufacturing services, including quick-turn PCB assembly (with 24-hour prototype capability), box-build integration, cable and wire-harness assembly, electromechanical assembly, conformal coating, and functional testing. Operations run out of more than 100,000 square feet of factory space, supporting volumes from low-volume pilot runs to high-volume production. The company cites state-of-the-art equipment and technical expertise as foundations of its service offering.

The company serves customers in oil and gas, industrial controls, communications, infrastructure, and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) that require mission-critical electronic assemblies for harsh environments.

Suntronic emphasizes quality built into the process rather than inspected in, maintaining ISO 9001:2015 certification and IPC-A-610-trained personnel. Its stated mission is to develop mutually profitable partnerships and to provide a challenging, rewarding workplace for employees.
